g.text: All-atom MD of four imidazolium [BF₄] ionic liquids in a (15,15) CNT
minimised structure in the repository, one sphere per atom
C2 to C8 chains; binding grows, mobility falls
per ion for [OMIM][BF₄] at the wall; 1.01 H-bonds per cation
